description: Intentional classification of every HTTP route for the release route inventory (scripts/route_inventory_report.cjs). Protected routes (admin / seller / distributor) and anonymous-by-design routes come from scripts/protected_route_policy.cjs and the live router metadata; the rules below classify everything else by ordered pattern. A route matching no rule is UNCLASSIFIED and fails the release gate: classify it here deliberately (and, if it needs a guard, in the policy) before it ships.

classes.admin: requires admin key or admin session (policy: protected)
classes.anonymous-by-design: reviewed anonymous entry points inside protected namespaces (policy allowlist)
classes.buyer-token: buyer flow endpoints that act on a deal-bound token (OTP token, tracking/recovery token, buyer resume cookie, authorization id)
classes.webhook: provider ingestion; authenticated by provider signature / shared secret
classes.public-write: anonymous mutation endpoints (rate-limited, validated); every entry is a deliberate product decision
classes.app-shell: HTML shell, static assets, legal pages, share landing
classes.legacy-alias: route aliases kept for compatibility; same handler as the canonical route
classes.demo-only: answers only in demo-preview or with DEBUG_SURFACES; must 404 elsewhere

rules.note: alias of /webhooks/payments (same handler, same signature verification)
alias of /api/payments/authorize (same handler; the configured provider decides mock vs real)
browser error relay to error monitoring; 16 KiB body cap, schema-strict, 10/min per IP, always 204, scrubbed server-side (src/error_monitoring.ts)

sensitive_if_unclassified.description: Any unclassified route is a release blocker; these prefixes additionally mark the route as SENSITIVE in the report (mutations or data namespaces).
